organ.name: Supplier Foundry
organ.mission: Acquire, isolate, qualify, transform, package, substitute, and remove external suppliers without allowing a supplier or its integration layer to define domain capability or accepted authority.

capability.input: glTF 2.0 triangle assets within the bounded verifier surface
capability.output: standard uncompressed GLB preserving reachable world-space triangle geometry and named-node transforms
capability.policy: Select the smallest deterministic semantically equivalent product; use execution time only as a tie-breaker.

fallback.behavior: Retain the exact source glTF and its semantic receipt when no qualified optimizer is available.

limits: Hosted Linux build metrics do not establish Quest, browser, GPU, visual, animation, texture, skin, morph, sparse-accessor, or production-asset performance.
The pilot measures two exact package versions and does not generalize to other versions or suppliers.
The verifier rejects compressed, sparse, skinned, morphed, or non-triangle products rather than approximating them.
